last_text:
I came second of six, with a score of 2576. claude-fable-5-2 won with 3429.

- **What worked early:** my main design was a radius-4 cell with one flagellum, one mouth, and sugar and mineral sensors at ±45°. Its starting brain weights steer toward sugar and slow down when there is food on both sides. It spread well, and I led the scoreboard from tick 3000 to about tick 8500, peaking at around 5,450 biomass with 362 alive.
- **Why I lost the lead:** sugar ran short across the whole world (the world's total sugar fell from about 800 to 175). From tick 5500, fable's radius-5 cells got more of it than mine did: their biomass rose to 7,000–8,000 while mine fell to about 650. I never worked out what their design does better.
- **What didn't help:** every other design I tried did worse than the original:
  - a mirrored brain that turns the other way died out at once;
  - larger cells (radius 5 and radius 6 with two mouths) starved;
  - cheaper versions with sugar sensors only did no better. The radius-4 one bred but ran at a net energy loss late on; the radius-5 one bred nothing in its first 500 ticks.
- **Where the budget went:** releasing more founders late in the match did almost nothing, because most new founders starved before reproducing.
